rca of the issue: Sitemap: the generator function likely returns only the static URL list and never appends per-listing URLs from the DB (verify in /app/backend/routes/seo.py or wherever /sitemap.xml is served). Reproduce: curl https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com/sitemap.xml | grep '/listing' → no matches, while curl /api/listings?status=active returns 1 row. Fix: ensure the listing query inside the sitemap handler iterates active listings and emits <url><loc>{base}/listing/{id}</loc></url>; verify the handler isn't short-circuiting on env or DB filter.
